capabilities: Publish articles as drafts to multiple WeChat Official Accounts at once
Format notes with 14 built-in CSS themes or custom CSS from the vault
Preview the formatted title, body, quotes, code blocks and images before publishing
Compress and upload body images and covers to the WeChat material library
Export the formatted article as a PNG long image to the note's folder
extras: Desktop-only (Windows, macOS, Linux). Must be installed manually from release files (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css). The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Publishing requires adding the server's outbound IP to the account's IP whitelist.
motivation: The author built it to reduce the repetitive work of formatting articles for WeChat and publishing to multiple accounts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to format notes for WeChat Official Accounts or push articles to one or more account draft boxes.

summary: WeChat publishing assistant that formats Markdown notes with themes and sends them as drafts to multiple WeChat Official Accounts.
